The Takara Tomy Duel Masters Tcg Dmex-07 Special Maximum The Master Pack Dp-Box Card Boxes is a collectible trading card set designed for enthusiasts and players of the Duel Masters trading card game. This set offers a unique selection of cards that enhance gameplay and provide collectors with valuable additions to their deck. Released by Takara Tomy, a reputable name in the trading card industry, it stands out for its special edition packaging and exclusive cards.

This product was launched to bring fresh excitement to Duel Masters fans with its maximum power cards and strategic elements. The Dmex-07 Special pack includes a variety of powerful cards that can significantly influence game tactics. Its release date adds context to the evolution of the Duel Masters series, making it a must-have for both new and veteran players looking to expand their collection.

Details

• Condition: New & Factory Sealed

• Manufacturer: Takara Tomy
